assertions.name: v2_t_vs_he3_distinct
assertions.source: V2 should distinguish isospin mirrors; >0 confirms

description: V2 mirror-chirality (genuine geometric mirror knot β*) wired via numeric per-irrep Hoefsmit at q_0 — the fast path that the V1 symbolic backfill (term5_aK_audit.py) couldn't handle for A ≥ 3. Confirms the V1 = τ(β²) double-winding finding from `2026-05-15-three-pr-integration.md` §V1≠mirror by exhibiting a structural T ↔ ³He asymmetry under V2 that V1 cannot resolve.

spin_involution_asymmetry_pct.interpretation: V1 = τ(β²) is conjugation-invariant; T ↔ ³He asymmetry under V1 must be 0 (or numerical zero). V2 = τ(β · β_mirror⁻¹) probes the genuine chirality; if T and ³He differ structurally as isospin mirrors, V2 should detect it. A non-zero V2 asymmetry confirms V2 carries information V1 loses by construction.

caveats: Mirror composition relies on the atom braid words containing only pure crossings ((1, 0) and (1, -h)). Averaged crossings (½(σ + σ⁻¹)) would require V4-style handling; not present in atom_braid_word_3A output.
V2 a_K is a Markov trace at numeric q_0 (float64 floor ~1e-13 for A=1, ~1e-10 for A=2 per global_wedderburn_sum_q_hecke_seminormal docstring).
